mapper.select: SELECT industry_name AS industryName, COUNT(*) AS appearDays, ROUND(AVG(change_pct), 2) AS avgChangePct, ROUND(AVG(turnover_yi), 2) AS avgTurnoverYi, ROUND(AVG(net_inflow_yi), 2) AS avgNetInflowYi, ROUND(SUM(net_inflow_yi), 2) AS totalNetInflowYi, ROUND(AVG(rank_num), 1) AS avgRank, MAX(leader) AS leader FROM signal_daily_industry WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY industry_name ORDER BY avgChangePct DESC

SELECT trade_date AS tradeDate, rank_num AS rankNum, change_pct AS changePct, turnover_yi AS turnoverYi, net_inflow_yi AS netInflowYi, leader FROM signal_daily_industry WHERE industry_name = #{industryName} AND trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY trade_date ASC
